title: A2FKP presentation at the Festival of Genomics & Biodata
summary: The Knowledge Portal team will present on the Association to Function Knowledge Portal at the Boston Festival of Genomic & Biodata, Oct. 4
bodyHtml: Join us in the "Genome Dome" at the Festival of Genomics & Biodata to learn about the Association to Function Knowledge Portal  (A2FKP)! We'll be holding a workshop at 11:40am on Wednesday, October 4. Register here for the workshop. We hope to see you there!
